oppyconnect.title: OppyConnect
oppyconnect.summary: The LinkBiz messaging app, published on the App Store and Google Play.
oppyconnect.problem: The platform needed its own conversation channel, with media, documents and voice, without relying on third-party apps.
oppyconnect.solution: I was the sole developer of the app and its chat API: one-to-one and group conversations, media, voice messages, search and push notifications.
oppyconnect.impact: A complete app in production on both stores, maintained by me end to end.

linkbiz.title: LinkBiz
linkbiz.summary: Networking platform that uses AI to connect professionals with business opportunities, on web, iOS and Android.
linkbiz.problem: A growing product with continuous demand for new features without giving up stability and security.
linkbiz.solution: On a team of 9 developers, I implemented opportunity recommendations with embeddings, the feed and payments: Stripe and Pix subscriptions, credits and gift cards.
linkbiz.impact: Steady delivery on a production app with real users.

duo.title: Duo
duo.summary: MCP bridge between two Claude Code instances: a Tech Lead delegates work to an Executor on another machine.
duo.problem: A single agent cannot hold the tech lead's overview and the hands on a project living on another machine at the same time.
duo.solution: MCP servers on both sides, networking over Tailscale, local semantic cache, task delegation and a publish barrier via protected branches.
duo.impact: A working agent-to-agent flow with real risk containment in Git.

telegram.title: claude-telegram-bridge
telegram.summary: Self-hosted bridge that pings you on Telegram when a Claude Code session finishes and lets you continue it from the chat.
telegram.problem: Long agent sessions meant sitting at the computer just to know when they ended or needed a decision.
telegram.solution: Per-OS binaries, long-polling with no public server, multiple projects and users on one bot, hooks installed automatically.
telegram.impact: Published with per-OS releases; a two-step setup.

gestai.title: GestAI and GestAI Hub
gestai.summary: Management system for dental clinic networks and a single customer-service inbox with an AI agent.
gestai.problem: Clinics talk to patients over WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and e-mail in separate channels, disconnected from scheduling, CRM and finance.
gestai.solution: In GestAI Hub, I built the visual editor for automated service flows and bulk WhatsApp campaigns. I developed the AI agent that answers patients from the clinic knowledge base (RAG) and integrated the GestAI CRM with the Hub.
gestai.impact: Every new contact automatically becomes an opportunity in the sales funnel, and the agent hands the conversation to a human when needed.

about.title: Product end to end, from the app in the store to the database.
about.p1: I am a Full Stack Developer based in São José dos Campos, Brazil. Since October 2025 I have worked at CDT Software, from the database to the interface, on SaaS products in production: GestAI, GestAI Hub, LinkBiz and OppyConnect. Before that I interned at SESI on internal systems, automation and support.
about.p2: I like shipping the whole product: the published app, the API behind it and a well-modelled database. Much of my work today is applied generative AI: customer-service agents, RAG and MCP.
about.p3: Degree in Systems Analysis and Development from Faculdade de Tecnologia SENAI Félix Guisard (2024 to 2025). Also: OOP and Databases with Java/SQL (Coursera) and Cybersecurity Defense Analyst (Cisco, in progress). Intermediate English.

who.q: Who is Victor Augusto Ferreira dos Santos?
who.a: Victor Augusto Ferreira dos Santos is a full-stack developer in São José dos Campos, Brazil. He works at CDT Software on SaaS products in production (GestAI, GestAI Hub, LinkBiz and OppyConnect) and maintains open-source tooling for AI-agent workflows.

work.q: Where does Victor Augusto work and with which technologies?
work.a: He has been a Full Stack Developer at CDT Software since October 2025. Day to day he uses TypeScript, React and React Native, Node.js, Python, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL and AWS, plus AI agents with RAG and MCP.

remote.a: Based in São José dos Campos, Brazil. Experience with an on-site team at CDT Software and with remote projects.

opensource.q: Which open-source projects does Victor Augusto maintain?
opensource.a: Duo (an MCP bridge between two Claude Code instances), claude-telegram-bridge and two VS Code extensions: AI Diff Tracker and Mini Browser.

duo.q: What is Duo (an MCP bridge between two Claude Code instances)?
duo.a: A pair of MCP servers linking two Claude Code instances: a Tech Lead delegates tasks to an Executor on another machine, over Tailscale, with a local semantic cache and publishing only through protected branches.

telegram.a: A self-hosted bridge that pings you on Telegram when a Claude Code session finishes and lets you keep replying from the chat. It uses long-polling, needs no public server and ships per-OS binaries.

contact.q: How do I contact Victor Augusto?
contact.a: By e-mail at victoroow@gmail.com or on LinkedIn. The PDF resume is linked at the top of the page.
